title: 2012 SAGE Hit #73 Chris Polk Washington Huskies Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2012 SAGE Hit Football Card featuring Chris Polk of the Washington Huskies. The card is part of the base set and is a rookie card. It has not been autographed and is an original card from the manufacturer, SAGE. The card number is #73 and it is a sports trading card for football fans. This item is a great addition to any collection and is perfect for those who love the NFL and sports memorabilia.
